lead.headline: 706 finished US drug and device trials, 8.6% of those the law covers, never posted results: 152,850 patients
lead.number: 706 of 8,234 FDA-regulated US phase 2-4 trials that finished 2017-01-18 to 2022-06-30 have no results as of 2026-09-04, covering 152,850 enrolled patients.
lead.watch_out: A long tail: 435 of 537 sponsors miss exactly one, and TrialsTracker already ranks sponsors.

Analyses found that only 41% (1,722/4,209) of completed clinical trials reported results within the one year legal deadline, whilst 36% (1,523/4,209) still had not been reported by September 16, 2019. Moreover, progress has stalled--the proportion of compliant trials has remained stable since July 2018. The median delay from completion to submitting results was 424 days--59 days higher than the legal reporting requirement of one year (figure 1).
